notes.subject: רכליך
notes.rationale: Literol em i 'ol man i wokabaut long rot bilong salim samting' — mipela i tanim olsem man bilong bisnis

notes.subject: ויעף
notes.rationale: Root i tok 'flai' na tu 'pinitup' — samoling i tanim 'i flai i go we', narapela 'i pen na lus strong'

notes.subject: פשט
notes.rationale: Tok i gat tu min: 'sanap olgeta' na 'rausim klos/samting' — hia mipela i holim 'rausim' tasol

translation: Yu bin mekim planti ol man bilong salim samting bilong yu — moa long ol sta bilong heven; yelek i rausim olgeta samting na i go long balus ⟨i go we⟩.

tokens.gloss: ol man bilong salim samting bilong yu
